scope: Independent source-only review of EXT-D-0053/0054 export repairs and truthful copy feedback
verification: Source and test inspection only. No tests, build, browser, clipboard read, spreadsheet paste, mutation plant, or native UI verification was run by this peer.

A_outcome.verdict: Accept the four commits as a source-level repair of the reported long-string JSON loss, TSV separator/header loss, and false green success feedback in CopyMenu. Native acceptance remains open.
evidence: src/lib/clipboard/copy.ts:115-130 retains complete JSON-compatible strings and throws for JSON.stringify failures instead of copying a success-looking fallback.
src/lib/clipboard/copy.ts:169-186 quotes TSV headers and cells containing tab, CR, LF, or quote, doubles quotes, and preserves ordinary cells.

src/features/showcase/components/ResultPreview.tsx:62-86 sends the unsliced rows to JSON, TSV, and AI copy; src/features/showcase/tabs/PatternsTab.tsx:129-152,261-267 and src/features/data/DataView.tsx:228-236,493-527 feed the shared formatter paths from saved runs and manual reruns.

src/components/CopyMenu.tsx:117-133 records success only after copyToClipboard returns true; preparation errors and false writes record failure. Lines 158-166 and 188-203 render red failure feedback in single- and multi-option modes; the green check is restricted to success.
A_outcome.remaining_scope_limit: JSON-compatible saved rows are the supported losslessness claim. Standard JSON.stringify still omits undefined object fields, converts non-finite numbers to null, and honors toJSON. This peer did not establish a universal row-value contract.

B_quality.verdict: The focused tests target observable formatter output and the real CopyMenu state/action path, but their red/green and native behavior are unexecuted.
evidence: tests/unit/clipboard-export.test.ts:5-28 parses JSON and fenced AI JSON for two distinct long values and expects cycles and BigInt to be refused; reintroducing the former truncation changes the asserted values.
tests/unit/clipboard-export.test.ts:30-59 compares TSV with a worked literal and independently reads escaped fields, including a tab-containing header and distinct tab-versus-space values.

tests/unit/copy-menu-feedback.test.tsx:27-69 imports the real CopyMenu, exercises preparation failure, false clipboard return, and true clipboard return, and checks failure text/icon versus success icon. The clipboard function and popover presentation are the mocked external edges.

The popover mock always renders its content, so the test does not prove that a real open popover keeps the failure message visible. Source does not call setOpen(false) on failure; native UI must settle that behavior.
focused_verification_required_next: Run tests/unit/clipboard-export.test.ts and tests/unit/copy-menu-feedback.test.tsx plus the TypeScript check in the guarded native worker.

Prove a red assertion against the pre-repair formatter and prior truthy-feedback behavior in an isolated scratch context, and perform the required constant-return/gut-check mutations without editing the shared working tree.

In the installed extension, run a saved replay with more than 200 rows and a value longer than 50,000 characters; read exact JSON and AI clipboard bytes, including the last row. Repeat JSON from Data manual rerun.
Copy TSV from both Showcase and Data, paste into a spreadsheet, and compare tab/newline/quote-containing headers and cells with the extracted source.
Exercise successful, denied-write, and preparation-failure copy in real single- and multi-option controls; verify the menu and visible/accessible feedback reflect actual clipboard contents.
